scripts.script:
setclipboard("https://discord.gg/TR3quUFgT6")

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

local speedSpamEnabled = false
local autoRebirthEnabled = false

local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Events")
local addSpeed = remotes:WaitForChild("AddSpeed")
local requestRebirth = remotes:WaitForChild("RequestRebirth")

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "MetalUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
pcall(function()
    gui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")
end)

local main = Instance.new("Frame")
main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 220)
main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -130, 0.5, -110)
main.Active = true
main.Draggable = true
main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 10, 25)
main.BorderSizePixel = 0
main.Parent = gui

local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
corner.Parent = main

local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(170, 80, 255)
stroke.Thickness = 1.5
stroke.Parent = main

local topbar = Instance.new("Frame")
topbar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
topbar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 15, 40)
topbar.BorderSizePixel = 0
topbar.Parent = main

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 1, 0)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "auto farm"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(210, 180, 255)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 14
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.Parent = topbar

local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
close.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 1, 0)
close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 0)
close.Text = "-"
close.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 255)
close.BackgroundTransparency = 1
close.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
close.TextSize = 18
close.Parent = topbar

local body = Instance.new("Frame")
body.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -32)
body.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 32)
body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
body.Parent = main

local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
layout.Parent = body

local minimized = false
close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    minimized = not minimized
    body.Visible = not minimized
    main.Size = minimized and UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 32) or UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 220)
end)

local function makeToggle(text, callback)
    local state = false

    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 34)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 20, 50)
    btn.Text = text .. " : off"
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 210, 255)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    btn.TextSize = 13
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.Parent = body

    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    c.Parent = btn

    local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(140, 70, 220)
    s.Thickness = 1
    s.Parent = btn

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        state = not state
        btn.Text = text .. " : " .. (state and "on" or "off")
        callback(state)
    end)
end

local function makeButton(text, callback)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 34)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 25, 70)
    btn.Text = text
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 210, 255)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    btn.TextSize = 13
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.Parent = body

    local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    c.Parent = btn

    local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    s.Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 90, 255)
    s.Thickness = 1
    s.Parent = btn

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
end

makeToggle("speed spam", function(v)
    speedSpamEnabled = v
end)

makeToggle("auto rebirth", function(v)
    autoRebirthEnabled = v
end)

makeButton("copy discord", function()
    if setclipboard then
        setclipboard("https://discord.gg/TR3quUFgT6")
    end
end)

    while task.wait() do
        if speedSpamEnabled then
            pcall(function()
                addSpeed:FireServer()
            end)
        end
    end
end)

task.spawn(function()
    while task.wait(1) do
        if autoRebirthEnabled then
            pcall(function()
                requestRebirth:InvokeServer()
            end)
        end
    end
end)

scripts.title: VINQ Hub Hitbox Test Beta
scripts.script:
--=================================================================================================--
--                                VINQ HUB | HITBOX EXPANDER (TEST)                                --
--                                  DEVELOPMENT & TESTING ARCHITECTURE                            --
--=================================================================================================--

if not game:IsLoaded() then 
    game.Loaded:Wait() 
end

local _plrs_string = string.char(80,108,97,121,101,114,115)
local _plrs = game:GetService(_plrs_string)
local _lp = _plrs.LocalPlayer

-- UI Library Loading Layer
local _v_hook = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://github.com/dawid-scripts/Fluent/releases/latest/download/main.lua"))()

-- VINQ HUB GREY THEME STYLING ARRAYS
local _vinq_text_color = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
local _vinq_main_grey  = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
local _vinq_acc_grey   = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120)
local _vinq_back_dark  = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
local _vinq_line_grey  = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)

_v_hook.Options = {
    TextColor = _vinq_text_color,
    MainColor = _vinq_main_grey,
    AccentColor = _vinq_acc_grey,
    BackgroundColor = _vinq_back_dark,
    OutlineColor = _vinq_line_grey
}

-- Root Menu Architecture Execution Window
local _v_window = _v_hook:CreateWindow({
    Title = "VINQ HUB | Hitbox Expander (Test)",
    SubTitle = "Slap Battles Edition",
    TabWidth = 160,
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(580, 540), 
    Acrylic = false,
    Theme = "Dark",
    MinimizeKey = Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl
})

-- Dynamic Parameters (Runtime Configuration Memory Pointers)
local _cfg_enabled = false
local _cfg_width   = 10  
local _cfg_height  = 10   
local _cfg_depth   = 10   
local _cfg_trans   = 0.4 -- Lowered default for high visibility profile
local _cfg_team    = false

-- Allocation Framework Tables for Navigation Elements
local _v_tabs = {
    Hitbox = _v_window:AddTab({ Title = "Hitbox Expander", Icon = "target" }),
    BugsAndFixes = _v_window:AddTab({ Title = "Bugs And Fixes", Icon = "wrench" })
}

-- Auto-Focus Initial Workspace Profile
_v_window:SelectTab(_v_tabs.Hitbox)

--=================================================================================================--
-- TAB 1: HITBOX EXPANDER WORKING WORKSPACE
--=================================================================================================--

_v_tabs.Hitbox:AddParagraph({
    Title = "VINQ HITBOX TEST",
    Content = "Adjust length and scale parameters below. This is an official test profile."
})

local Tgl_1 = _v_tabs.Hitbox:AddToggle("HitboxToggle", { 
    Title = "Enable Hitbox Expander", 
    Default = false 
})

-- Master Linking Slider
local Sld_All = _v_tabs.Hitbox:AddSlider("SizeAllSlider", {
    Title = "Size All Together",
    Description = "Scales width, height, and depth uniformly",
    Default = 10, Min = 2, Max = 50, Rounding = 1
})

local Sld_W = _v_tabs.Hitbox:AddSlider("WidthSlider", {
    Title = "Hitbox Width (Left/Right)",
    Description = "Expands lateral alignment boundaries",
    Default = 10, Min = 2, Max = 50, Rounding = 1
})

local Sld_H = _v_tabs.Hitbox:AddSlider("HeightSlider", {
    Title = "Hitbox Height (Up/Down)",
    Description = "Modifies player height spacing profile",
    Default = 10, Min = 2, Max = 50, Rounding = 1
})

local Sld_D = _v_tabs.Hitbox:AddSlider("DepthSlider", {
    Title = "Hitbox Depth (Front/Back)",
    Description = "Adjusts standard forward depth profiling",
    Default = 10, Min = 2, Max = 50, Rounding = 1
})

local Sld_T = _v_tabs.Hitbox:AddSlider("TransSlider", {
    Title = "Hitbox Transparency",
    Description = "Grey box field opacity parameters (Lower = More Visible)",
    Default = 0.4, Min = 0, Max = 1, Rounding = 1
})

local Tgl_2 = _v_tabs.Hitbox:AddToggle("TeamToggle", { 
    Title = "Team Check", 
    Default = false 
})

--=================================================================================================--
-- TAB 2: BUGS AND FIXES INFORMATIONAL LOGS
--=================================================================================================--

_v_tabs.BugsAndFixes:AddParagraph({
    Title = "Beta Notice / Log Profiles",
    Content = "This is in beta. Don't think just because it's out doesn't mean it won't bug out. More updates soon! Maybe?"
})

--=================================================================================================--
-- RUNTIME CALLBACK MONITOR PIPELINES
--=================================================================================================--

Tgl_1:OnChanged(function(_val) 
    _cfg_enabled = _val 
    _v_hook:Notify({
        Title = "VINQ HUB STATUS",
        Content = _cfg_enabled and "Hitbox: on" or "Hitbox: off",
        Duration = 2
    })
end)

-- Intercept Master Slider to push value to sub-sliders
Sld_All:OnChanged(function(_val)
    _cfg_width = _val
    _cfg_height = _val
    _cfg_depth = _val
    Sld_W:SetValue(_val)
    Sld_H:SetValue(_val)
    Sld_D:SetValue(_val)
end)

Sld_W:OnChanged(function(_val) _cfg_width = _val end)
Sld_H:OnChanged(function(_val) _cfg_height = _val end)
Sld_D:OnChanged(function(_val) _cfg_depth = _val end)
Sld_T:OnChanged(function(_val) _cfg_trans = _val end)
Tgl_2:OnChanged(function(_val) _cfg_team = _val end)

--=================================================================================================--
-- ASYNCHRONOUS ENGINE LOOP TRACKER
--=================================================================================================--

task.spawn(function()
    while true do 
        task.wait(0.1) 
        
        if _cfg_enabled and _lp then
            for _, p in ipairs(_plrs:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= _lp then
                    if not _cfg_team or (_cfg_team and p.Team ~= _lp.Team) then
                        pcall(function()
                            local character = p.Character
                            local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            
                            if root then
                                -- Custom structural highly visible grey configurations applied here
                                root.Size = Vector3.new(_cfg_width, _cfg_height, _cfg_depth)
                                root.Transparency = _cfg_trans
                                root.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Dark stone grey")
                                root.Material = Enum.Material.Neon -- Neon material makes it highly visible in combat arenas
                                root.CanCollide = false
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
        else
            -- Automatic safe cleanup/reset sequence when toggled completely off
            for _, p in ipairs(_plrs:GetPlayers()) do
                pcall(function()
                    local character = p.Character
                    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    
                    if root then
                        root.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 1)
                        root.Transparency = 1
                        root.CanCollide = true
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end
end)

--=================================================================================================--
-- INITIAL INJECTION BOOT NOTIFICATION DISPATCH
--=================================================================================================--

_v_hook:Notify({
    Title = "VINQ HUB TEST",
    Content = "Lol using a hub in slap battles in 2026 bro. Imagine. Tbh i still do that so yeah, anyways enjoy the script, more bugs are gonna be fixed for the hitbox. THIS IS ONLY A TEST OF VINQ HUB HITBOX TEST",
    Duration = 10
})

scripts.title: Projectile bigger hitbox
scripts.script:
local MULTIPLIER = 30

local function makeBigger(part)
    if not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end

    part.Size = part.Size * MULTIPLIER
    part.CanTouch = true
    part.CanQuery = true
    part.CanCollide = true

    -- important for consistent touch detection
    part.Massless = true
end

local function isProjectile(obj)
    return obj.Name == "Projectile"
        or obj.Name == "Fireball"
        or obj.Name == "Iceball"
        or obj.Name == "Table"
        or obj.Name == "RAIGTable"
        or obj.Name == "Pellet"
        or obj.Name == "Soccerball"
        or obj.Name == "BigRocket"
        or obj.Name == "Rocket"
        or obj.Name == "Basketball"
        or obj.Name == "Molotov"
        or obj.Name == "Grenade"
        or obj.Name == "Cesusbomb"
        or obj.Name == "Cesuspot"
        or obj.Name == "LilCesuspot"
        or obj.Name == "Banana"
        or obj.Name == "Pie"
        or obj.Name == "Brew"
        or obj.Name == "Goala"
        or obj.Name == "Cola"
        or obj.Name == "FireTeapot"
        or obj.Name == "Teapot"
end

local function applyToObject(obj)
    if isProjectile(obj) then
        if obj:IsA("Model") then
            for _, d in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
                makeBigger(d)
            end
        else
            makeBigger(obj)
        end
    end
end

-- handle existing objects
for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
    applyToObject(obj)
end

-- handle new ones
workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
    task.wait() -- ensures properties are ready
    applyToObject(obj)
end)
